text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day of the Kikuka Sho finally arrives. In the lead-up to the big race, the waiting room is completely silent.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today's the culmination of months of hard work. Manhattan Cafe's raw power will be put to the test.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This might be the race where she reaches her friend. Manhattan Cafe heads for the race with a smile that suggests she's confident it'll happen.
